text:
I escape a feint, filament by filament.

A projectile—I do not know where it will fall.

Uncertainty. Sundown. Cervical joint.


Snap of a blowfly dying

halfway through its flight and falling to earth.

What does Newton say now?

But naturally, you are children.


Uncertainty. Heels that do not turn.

Little face knotted, forge-wrought,

five thorns along one side

and five along the other: Hush! It is coming out.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem XII — I Escape a Feint, Filament by Filament
translation.editorial_note: Scientific causality, anatomy, and birth-like emergence remain deliberately disjointed; fabrida is rendered as forge-wrought.
